summary: No held thesis is broken by evidence in today's files. Every held equity (CARG, DPZ, IDXX, INCY, KR, MSCI, SAM, VRSN) was still on the 11-24 menu, and each one's stored fundamentals premise (F-score, gp_sector_pct, CFO above net income) matches the numbers on that menu. The book ended with all nine stop blocks 'ok' and no stop_alerts, at $615.73 equity (+2.62% since inception vs SPY -6.22%). The only fill was the $15 TLT add, which has no fundamentals case. SAM is the nearest to its stop (5.33% above $201). That is a price fact; nothing in the files hurts SAM's fundamentals.
